title: Someone Rides Dad's Scooter At 2 A.M. 🤖

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Guys. [beat] Dad's scooter. [beat] Garage. [beat] 2 a.m. [beat] GONE.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: GONE?! [beat] Bro, your dad sleeps like a brick! [beat] Who's riding it?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That's the thing. [beat] The scooter comes BACK at 4 a.m. [beat] With a FULL tank.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: Full tank. [beat] Ghost riders pay for fuel. [beat] I've said this for YEARS.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Focus. [beat] Dad's slippers — mud on them every morning. [beat] There's construction by the river road.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The river road?! [beat] That's where the FOOD CARTS park at night! [beat] I know the egg-roll guy there!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So they followed the mud. [beat] Three kids. One bicycle. [beat] 2 a.m.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: WAIT. [beat] Is that— [beat] that's NIX'S DAD! [beat] Why is he carrying FOOD CARTS?!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Nix?! [beat] Go home. [beat] It's late, beta.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dad… [beat] every night? [beat] You help the cart guys EVERY night?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: The flood took their carts. [beat] They have children too. [beat] A man doesn't need applause for this. [beat] Go home.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The kids went home. [beat] The scooter came back at 4. [beat] And nobody ever told Rafiq… [beat] they'd started leaving breakfast orders for the cart guys on it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My dad's a secret hero! [beat] Follow for part two — [beat] because next week… [beat] the helmet cam sees EVERYTHING.
